title: BDUK OMR publication and ONS postcode epoch-binding guards

findings.finding: Collection last updated 4 June 2026; January 2026 OMR is latest listed premises-level release.
OMR closed 1 June; submissions are being evaluated; postcode and UPRN outputs will be published once completed.
current_gigabit may miss post-January delivery and supplier-return gaps; future_gigabit is OMR-only and may miss later contracts.
Quarterly product contains current and terminated postcodes for geography/lifecycle binding.
Live product contains centroids for live postcodes as at May 2026; geography only.

decisions: Never upgrade BDUK January premise epoch using May ONS geography
Never infer broadband from live postcode/centroid
Keep exact premise/postcode provenance before parcel binding
